title: The unfinished aperture
anchors: Warm directional light against cool steel
Independent RiftScry wordmark and restrained mono labels
device: Three solid brass arc leaves detach from a closed circular instrument, separate into parallel planes, then turn edge-on to expose their relationships. A followed field brings the same leaf forward across events. At the finding, matching endpoints align; nonmatching endpoints stay offset. The leaves reassemble as an open aperture at the ending. This is an editorial investigation instrument, not a gameplay model.
